native.observed_metadata_policy: Boot-backup and first-screen keys are read-only, potentially volatile across app launches, and excluded from owned-setting comparisons and restoration writes.
known_limits: A rapid restore/reapply stress cycle encountered an owned-baseline mismatch and rolled back safely. A subsequent guarded apply succeeded; final live owned settings matched the saved Prism plan after launch. The initiating actor/timing was not established. Never weaken owned-setting guards or retry without checking the saved original baseline.

evidence_note: Owner-tested fullscreen Home/Settings, app/input opening, physical Home, standby/cold boot and prior-Home recovery. The 0.2.7 startup fix was also cold-boot tested without the incorrect Settings flash. See notes for per-check builds and read-only backup metadata behavior.
